scopeChanges.text: M0 includes the import of the Pagewing core (no UI) from the `v1.0.0` tag as the project skeleton: unchanged import, scripted rename, a commit that makes the subset self-contained, and the translation of German text. The listed tasks for the skeleton, `.gitignore` and CI are carried out on top of the imported solution. `.env.example` is not needed because the imported code uses no secrets. Decided in the suite spec and in `Docs/DECISIONS.md` (entry "Core-only import, fresh UI, new order of work").

milestones.title: Repo skeleton & CI
milestones.goal: A set-up repo with the renamed Pagewing core, tests and CI on which all further milestones build.

tasks.text: Create the spec (brainstorming): goal, scope, stack, subprojects; link it here and enter the first milestones
Repo setup done: `dev` as default branch, merge options, branch protection for `main` and `dev`
Fill in the project header of `CLAUDE.md` and `README.md`, remove the template section from the README
Import commit 1: the Pagewing core (`Core`, `Pdfium`, `Ocr`, `Cli`), its tests, test data and licence files from the `v1.0.0` tag, unchanged, with a stack-specific `.gitignore`
Import commit 2: scripted rename (dry run first), updater keys and URLs replaced by documented placeholders
Make the subset self-contained and green: solution file, removal of App-coupled tests, OCR library fetch script, `.editorconfig`; project skeleton incl. test projects
Translate the imported German comments, strings and test names to English
`.env.example` with placeholders, if secrets are needed (not needed, see scope change)
CI (GitHub Actions): build, test and format/lint on PRs to `dev` and `main`; the job `roadmap` from `.github/workflows/roadmap.yml` stays; aggregate check `ci`
Record the build, test and format/lint commands in `CLAUDE.md` and write the README setup section
Enter the CI jobs (`roadmap` and `ci`) as required status checks in the branch protection of `main` and `dev` (only on the owner's explicit instruction)
Dependabot for the package ecosystem and GitHub Actions

acceptance.text: Before the rename, every imported file is byte-identical to the `v1.0.0` tag (`diff -r` against a `git archive` of the same paths)
acceptance.evidence: `diff -r` of a fresh `git archive` against every imported path before commit 1: no differences; the final review compared all 628 blobs of commit b128acd with the tag: none differ; 80 binary fixtures compared after the rename: none changed

acceptance.text: No reference to Pagewing remains outside the allowlist (test `NoPagewingLeftoverTests`), and the updater trusts no Pagewing key or URL
acceptance.evidence: `NoPagewingLeftoverTests.TextFilesMentionPagewingOnlyWhereTheFixturesDo` fails with a planted mention in `NuGet.config` and passes without it; `UpdateTrustTests.TheReleaseBuildDoesNotTrustThePagewingReleaseKeyOrReleases` failed first (RED) and passes

acceptance.text: Build, test and format/lint run green locally (commands in `CLAUDE.md`), with no skipped OCR tests
acceptance.evidence: `dotnet build Raffica.slnx -c Release`: 0 warnings, 0 errors; `RAFFICA_REQUIRE_OCR=1 dotnet test Raffica.slnx -c Release --no-build --max-parallel-test-modules 1`: 3,409 run, 0 failed, 21 skipped (OS-specific or opt-in measurement tests, none for OCR); `dotnet format Raffica.slnx --verify-no-changes`: exit 0 (Windows)

acceptance.text: CI is green on a PR to `dev`
acceptance.evidence: PR 5, run 41604111774: `build-linux` (3,409 run, 0 failed), `build-windows` (3,409 run, 0 failed), `ci` and `roadmap` green

acceptance.text: Branch protection for `main` and `dev` is active: PR required, CI check required, no force push, no deletion
acceptance.evidence: `gh api repos/benjo-code/raffica/branches/dev/protection` and `.../main/protection` (2026-11-03): required checks `roadmap` and `ci` (strict), PR required, force pushes false, deletions false

acceptance.text: The measured values are recorded and the speed targets are set from them
acceptance.evidence: `measure.yml` runs on the three machines (`dev` at 0480960): Linux 41682565866, Windows 41683058597, macOS 41687457617 (indicative), cold after a reboot Windows 41689113140 and Linux 41689118537; raw CSVs and budget table in `Docs/measurements/shell-probe-2026-11-03/`; budgets and limits for Windows and Linux in `Docs/DECISIONS.md`, entry "Speed targets of the frame (M1)". backlog.title: ODF and legacy Microsoft formats
backlog.text: Support for ODF (.odt, .ods, .odp) and the old .doc, .xls and .ppt formats, after the main apps are built.

backlog.title: Clean up references to Pagewing documents and translate the fixture catalogue
backlog.text: About 68 imported files cite Pagewing's German decision-log entries or `packaging/README.md` in comments; the references point at documents that are not in this repo. `testdata/pdfs/LICENSES.md` is still German and describes fixtures generated by `tools/make-testpdfs.cs`, which was not imported. Replace the references with Raffica entries or drop them, translate the catalogue, and decide whether to import or rebuild the test PDF generator.

backlog.title: Build the OCR library in this repository
backlog.text: `tools/native-fetch.cs` fetches the Tesseract library from a pinned prerelease of the Pagewing repository. Build it here (workflow and build scripts) before the suite ships OCR, and put the CodeQL, release and hardware-measure workflows back where they are needed.
